articles.title: PHP flaw draws millions of exploit attempts, Cloudflare CEO warns
articles.snippet: Cloudflare’s Matthew Prince said the network saw thousands of exploit attempts even before the PHP vulnerability was publicly disclosed.

articles.title: Mastercard Opens Up AI Agent Payments With Early Access and Live Demo
articles.snippet: At Cloudflare Connect, the company demoed an AI agent running a sample ad campaign across nine payments to two merchants on a single approved budget.
